description.zh: 访问控制实例名称。名称长度为2~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
description.en: The name of the access control instance. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. The name can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh: 节点在被添加或恢复后，是否自动加入集群并开始提供服务
description.en: Specifies whether a node automatically joins the cluster and starts providing services after the node is added or recovered.

description.zh: RemindUnit（对象类型）为NODE（任务节点）时，监控的任务节点ID。多个ID之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔，一个规则最多监控50个节点。
description.en: The IDs of the monitored nodes when RemindUnit (object type) is set to NODE (node). Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 50 nodes can be monitored per rule.

description.zh:
若希望查询云原生版读写分离架构实例中只读节点的指标，您在传入具体**NodeId**的同时，还需要在本参数传入**READONLY**。
>  其余情况请无需传入（或传入**MASTER**）。
description.en:
To query the metrics of a read-only node in a cloud-native read/write splitting architecture instance, set this parameter to **READONLY** and specify the **NodeId** parameter.
>  In other cases, you do not need to specify this parameter or you can set it to **MASTER**.
The region in which the instance resides.

description.zh: 访问端点所在的专有网络ID。
description.en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) in which the endpoint resides.

descriptions.zh: <props="china">更多关于实例账号的信息，请参见[账号管理](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/172163.html)。</props>
descriptions.en: <props="china">For more information about instance accounts, see [Account management](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/172163.html).</props>.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardbx create-custom-endpoint --db-instance-name pxc-hzjasd0000 --name ext-win-live-17 --vpc-id vpc-bp1ndoug37dtwoedlmru0 --vswitch-id vsw-000000000 --node-ids r-bp1l5kfgw80000c3iv --node-auto-enter true --node-role READONLY --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
